purpose: Correlate >5% surface-risk trail errors with full-resolution motion geometry after authority attribution isolated transported surface memory.

interpretation.conclusion: Persistent surface memory dominates recovery errors even though the same error pixels almost never have current-surface, vacated, or effective-motion geometry. PreviousProtectionState is always marked valid and falls back to same-coordinate sampling when no transport wins; after a reveal becomes stable, stableSourceGate can therefore re-authorize stale same-coordinate risk. Test persistent-risk seeding only after repeated/opposing-transition evidence while retaining current-frame mitigation for the first ambiguous transition.
